title: Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.27428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transduced language models (TLMs) compose a pretrained \emph{source} language model with a functional finite-state transducer to induce a language model over \emph{target} strings. Computing the probability of a target prefix under a TLM amounts to summing the source-model probabilities of all source strings that the transducer maps to target strings beginning with that prefix. This set can be exponentially large or infinite. Prior work uses a computational shortcut based on source prefix probabilities, then approximates the resulting sum with threshold-pruned beam summing. This produces a lower bound with unknown error. Instead, we resample source prefixes without replacement and reweight each selected prefix by the inverse of its inclusion probability. tldr: 该论文提出一种通过无放回重采样和逆包含概率加权递归校正的无偏估计方法，用于高效计算转导语言模型中目标前缀概率，并准确估计阈值剪枝带来的质量损失。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unbiased estimator for target prefix probabilities in transduced language models via sampling without replacement and inverse inclusion probability weighting, enabling accurate estimation of mass lost by threshold pruning.
